Shopify merchants can also integrate via Business Hub or their backend.....

item.title: Adobe MAX Makes Its Move: Photoshop Can Relight and Clean Up Reflections, and It Wants to Hand the Software Over to AI Agents to Control
item.description: At Adobe MAX 2026, Adobe announced a series of AI updates for the Creative Cloud suite, emphasizing that AI is no longer just a button in Photoshop, but is taking a seat at the editing desk. The updates cover photo editing and video editing, and open interfaces to third-party agents. Photoshop adds 'Relight,' which can add and adjust light source position, color, and brightness out of thin air without changing the original image; 'Generative Restyle' can generate multiple style versions based on text and then fine-tune them; features such as 'Remove' have also been upgraded.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: OpenAI Directly Declares War on Google Maps: Launches ChatGPT Business Information Profiles, Officially Entering Local Business Search with 1.2 Billion Monthly Active Users
item.description: Competition in AI commercialization is extending from online virtual conversations to offline brick-and-mortar businesses. OpenAI recently launched the beta version of "Businesses in ChatGPT," providing businesses with a dedicated business information management platform. Industry insiders believe this move directly challenges the Google Business Profiles system that Google has built over many years, marking OpenAI's official entry into the local business listing market and launching an all-out offensive in this field.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Siri AI Is Finally About to Understand Your Health Checkup Data, but Apple Has Locked It in Beta
item.description: On November 11, @itspdfu leaked that in the first developer preview Beta of iOS 27.3, Apple embedded a feature toggle for Siri AI to read the "Health" app, code-named "IF / HealthSearch", which is currently turned off. The feature is intended to connect health information to Siri's "Search" tool, covering 92 HealthKit data types. It can look up recent records as well as historical data, aiming to fill Siri's gap in health data.

item.title: OpenAI Q3 Revenue Surges to $10 Billion: Up Nearly 50% Quarter-over-Quarter, Enterprise Business Doubles in a Single Quarter
item.description: On Tuesday, U.S. Eastern Time, OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar disclosed the latest financial and business data in an interview. In the third quarter, OpenAI's quarterly revenue grew nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter to $10 billion, with annualized revenue of about $50 billion, showing exceptionally rapid growth. Its enterprise business doubled in a single quarter, becoming the core growth engine. The pace of commercialization and monetization in the AI industry is reshaping outside perceptions, and OpenAI's financial performance highlights its strong momentum.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview: 280 billion parameters, 1M-token context; weights to be open-sourced on November 25
item.description: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, with a total parameter count of 280 billion and 14 billion activated per token, supporting a context length of up to 1 million tokens. The model excels in programming, 3D modeling, knowledge work, and content creation, and achieves competitive results on benchmarks such as Terminal-Bench and AutomationBench. Programming is the core upgrade highlight, covering everything from fixing and iterating on real codebases to fully building complex applications, and it can plan and execute in long-horizon development tasks.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: OpenAI Cuts Old Voice Modes as GPT-Live Takes Over, but Users Aren't Convinced
item.description: On November 11, OpenAI announced that it will retire ChatGPT's Advanced and Standard old voice modes on December 11, 2026, and concentrate development resources on GPT-Live, launched in July this year. GPT-Live uses a full-duplex architecture, enabling it to respond while listening to the user without waiting for them to finish, and to hand complex tasks to frontier text models without interrupting the conversation. The old turn-taking conversation mode will thus be retired.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Hongguo Short Drama Gives AI Characters an Official Identity: Virtual Avatars Can Now Have Their Rights Confirmed
item.description: The proliferation of AI faces in micro short dramas has made it difficult to determine whose face it is, who authorized it, and who owns it. On November 9, the Hongguo Short Drama Creator Center announced the launch of virtual avatar creation and rights confirmation capabilities, issuing "identity cards" for AI virtual avatars. Creators must submit prior evidence from one of three sources—real-person authorization, IP authorization, or original design—for filing, so as to first clarify ownership. This move aims to address the intricate chain of rights behind AI virtual avatars, clarify sources and ownership, and reduce authorization disputes.
item.dc:creator: AIBase
